text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-inference-prod (high latency, EU region)
incident-bot: Trigger: inference_service.latency_p50 > 350ms for 3m, alert_id=ALRT-9812

Sam Rivera: on it, grabbing logs + taking initial ack.
Sam Rivera: @ops-oncall can you confirm if any recent deploys to eu-dedicated?

Maya Chen: I didn't touch prod; last change was a config tweak to autoscaler yesterday but only for staging.

Liam Patel: Acked in PD. I'm on-call now. Seeing spike in 5xx and long tail responses from kv-cache layer.

Sam Rivera: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-15T11:05:21Z] inference-eu-01 inference_request id=abcd1234 status=503 latency=1201ms route=embed /kvcache/miss
[2026-03-15T11:05:22Z] inference-eu-02 inference_request id=abcd1235 status=200 latency=890ms route=chat /kvcache/hit
[2026-03-15T11:05:23Z] autoscaler eu-autoscaler scale_event desired=0->4 reason=burst
```

Maya Chen: Hmm kvcache miss rate jumped. Could be eviction storm after recent config change to expiration TTL.

Liam Patel: Copy. I'm triggering a scaling override for eu-dedicated to 8 to buy time. Command: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/autoscaler/eu/override -d '{"replicas":8}'`

ops-oncall: override accepted, scheduled. Should be up in ~90s.

Sam Rivera: While scaling comes up, recommend routing burst traffic to us-west fallback pool + enable model-variant fallback (smaller quantized).
Sam Rivera: ops-oncall can you flip the routing rule? quick command: `rbctl route set inference-prod region-preference eu,us-west fallback=true`

ops-oncall: applying fallback route now. rolling out to edge routers.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert escalated to tier2 due to continued errors after ack (auto-escalation).

Jordan Kline: Jumping on bridge to coordinate customer comms. What customers impacted?

Liam Patel: Exporting top-5 customers by error rate now -> sending CSV to #private-cust-updates. TL;DR: three high-volume customers seeing slowed responses (~2-3s p50 -> 8-12s p50) and some 503s for embeddings endpoints.

Maya Chen: Quick mitigation: bump kvcache TTL from 30s -> 300s for eu pool to reduce thrash. Command: `rbctl config set /services/inference/kvcache/ttl 300 --env=eu`
Maya Chen: Doing it now.

Sam Rivera: Nice. Also enabling prefix-KV caching for embeddings requests to reduce backend load.

ops-oncall: TTL change applied. Confirmed reduced eviction logs incoming. Scaling override completed, new pods healthy.

Liam Patel: Metrics look better but latency still above SLO on some routes. US fallback is taking load; we'd like to avoid customer-impacting failover for too long.

Jordan Kline: Drafting customer update: "We're investigating elevated request latency in EU. We've applied mitigation (temporary scaling and cache TTL change) and routed traffic to a fallback region. We're monitoring and expect improvement within 30 minutes. We'll update again in 15 minutes or sooner if status changes." Thoughts?

Sam Rivera: thumbs up. Add note: "No data loss, requests may be slightly slower while fallback is active."

Maya Chen: :+1: send when you have the list of affected accounts attached. Jordan, I'll DM the CSV.

ops-oncall: FYI we saw autoscaler thrash due to pod termination race; I've raised a ticket to add a stabilizing window to avoid immediate scaling down after burst.

Liam Patel: I'll follow up with a temporary runbook checklist for oncall: 1) scale override 2) set TTL 3) route fallback 4) collect trace IDs 5) notify customers 6) create follow-up incident for postmortem.

Sam Rivera: I'm going to hand this off to Jordan for customer liaison + follow-through. Jordan, you'll take ownership for the next 2 hours, ping me if any rollback required.

Jordan Kline: Taking ownership. I'll post updates every 15m or on major milestone. First update sent to affected customers and #customer-ops.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ownership transferred to Jordan Kline (ack token: ack-7f3c).

Maya Chen: Leaving monitoring on infra dashboards; will stay available in thread.

Sam Rivera: Thanks team. Postmortem owners: Liam + Maya, Jordan will coordinate customer notes.

Jordan Kline: Understood. Current ETA to resolution: 20-30m. Will update at +15m.

ops-oncall: note: setting follow-up task to add 300s TTL as a temporary safety knob for peak windows.

Sam Rivera: :white_check_mark: closing my active loop, handing monitoring to Jordan.

Jordan Kline: Update at +12m: metrics trending down, 5xx rate falling from 0.9% -> 0.12%, p50 latency for embeddings back to ~700ms from 2.1s. Continuing to watch.

Jordan Kline: Update at +30m: steady. removing fallback routing in 5m and will scale down eu pool to expected steady state after that. Preparing incident summary for postmortem.

incident-bot: This thread was marked resolved in PagerDuty (incident closed)

Jordan Kline: Final note: root cause suspected config edge case in kvcache eviction combined with autoscaler cooldown; postmortem will include reproduction steps and a mitigation to avoid immediate scale-down after bursts.

Sam Rivera: Thanks everyone. Great quick ops. :clap:
